_note: Weights hosted on Hugging Face Hub as subfolders of a single repo. Load a specific model with: AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(hf_repo, subfolder=subfolder).

stage1_gatekeeper.description: None Detection (Stage 1): binary classifier separating None from the four substantive legal-role categories.

stage2_text_only_4way.description: Four-Way Role Classification (Stage 2): role classifier trained and evaluated only on gold legally-labelled sentences.

text_only_5way.description: Direct five-way classifier: predicts None or one of the four legal roles jointly.

ovr_beoordeling.description: One-vs-Rest binary detector for the beoordeling (judicial reasoning) role.

ovr_beslissing.description: One-vs-Rest binary detector for the beslissing (court's decision) role.

ovr_materiele_feiten.description: One-vs-Rest binary detector for the materiele feiten (material facts) role.

ovr_proceshandelingen.description: One-vs-Rest binary detector for the proceshandelingen (submissions) role.
